title: agency-agents is a free repo with 280 AI employees for your business
description:
agency-agents: https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents

One assistant can't run a company.

You've been asking it to anyway.

Same chat. Same context. Every job.

Legal question, then a landing page.

It does both badly.

agency-agents takes the opposite approach.

280 specialists in one folder.

Engineers. Designers. Marketers. Salespeople.

There are even lawyers in there.

Each one has its own way of working.

Its own tools and capabilities.

So it isn't one assistant wearing hats.

One install drops all 280 on your laptop.

Like staffing a whole agency in an afternoon.

Everyone already knows their job.

You stop prompting harder.

You start delegating properly.

The whole thing is free on GitHub.

#agencyagents #aiagents #claudecode #github #automation
